uncited: *   **Virtual Plane:** Defined by a point $p$ (intersection point on isosurface) and a normal vector $N$.
*   **Update Ratio ($n$):** The ratio of the haptic control loop rate to the virtual plane update rate.
The virtual plane is updated every $n$ control loops.
*   **Multiple Solutions (Ambiguity):** In concave regions, the condition "surface normal equals HIP-to-VHIP vector" may have multiple solutions.
*   **Embedded VHIP:** If the VHIP is calculated to be inside the surface, it is violently accelerated out.
*   **Noisy Data:** Detailed variations in noisy volumetric data (e.g., soft tissue) can cause unrealistic force feedback.
*   **Time Complexity:** The haptic control loop performs tri-linear interpolation and vector operations.
The virtual plane update (every $n$ loops) adds gradient computation (central differences).
